hero.title: Welcome to dhbwCloud Self-Service
hero.introBoth: This portal is where you request <1>your own cloud project</1> — your space in the DHBW cloud with the resources you need — and where you give the services you run there <2>their own hostnames</2> and <3>TLS certificates</3>.
hero.introProjects: This portal is where you request <1>your own cloud project</1> — your space in the DHBW cloud with the CPU, RAM and storage you need.
hero.introDns: This portal is where you manage <1>your own DNS zones</1>. A zone gives you your own <2>hostnames</2> — the basis for reaching your services by name and for issuing <3>TLS certificates</3> for them.

project.title: 1 · Request a project
project.own: A project is your own space in the DHBW cloud, with the CPU, RAM and storage you ask for
project.instant: Small requests are often approved instantly
project.together: Add fellow students to it so you can work on it together

zone.title: 2 · Give it a DNS name
zone.activate: Activate your personal zone in Zone Management
zone.hostnames: You get your own hostnames, e.g. myapp.you.users.dhbw.cloud
zone.point: Point them at your machines (A / AAAA / CNAME); each zone has a TSIG key for ddclient, nsupdate or external-dns

tls.title: 3 · Get TLS certificates
tls.issue: Issue certificates with cert-manager once the hostname resolves
tls.manifests: Ready-to-copy manifests in the "TLS Certificates" tab
tls.acme: Uses the DHBW ACME server (see below)

zoneOnly.title: 1 · Activate a zone
zoneOnly.basis: This is the basis for records and certificates

records.title: 2 · Add DNS records
records.point: Point a hostname at your service (A / AAAA / CNAME)
records.tsig: Each zone comes with its own TSIG key
records.automate: Automate updates with ddclient, nsupdate, or external-dns

acme.title: TLS certificates: use the DHBW ACME server
acme.body: For the zones you create here you <1>must</1> obtain TLS certificates from DHBW's own ACME certificate authority at <2>{{host}}</2>. These zones are set up to authorize only the DHBW CA (via CAA records), so public CAs such as <3>Let's Encrypt can not be used</3> for these hostnames. The DHBW server is free, has no public rate limits, and also issues certificates for services that are only reachable from <4>inside the DHBW network / VPN</4>. Each zone's <5>TLS Certificates</5> tab generates cert-manager manifests pre-filled for exactly this server.
